channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Japan wins men’s team gold at world gymnastics championships
item.description: Japan prevailed under pressure, thanks in large part to an excellent routine from Daiki Hashimoto on the horizontal bar.

item.title: Japan’s export growth stays solid, supported by chips and cars
item.description: The export gain highlighted ongoing demand related to artificial intelligence, with shipments of semiconductors and chip-making equipment surging.

item.title: Nobel Prize winner Soai delivers lecture in Tokyo about reaction named after him
item.description: In his lecture, Kenso Soai discussed the Soai reaction, which led to him winning the 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry.

item.title: New project aims to create AI medical image-processing system in Japan
item.description: The goal is to realize the real-time image processing required at medical sites with the use of advanced semiconductors.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
